title: Have You Gotten Acne From Wearing a Mask?
paragraphs: The past year, we were forced to wear masks. It has increased acne and skin irritation for many people. “Mask-ne,” as it is called, is a part of a category of another well-known condition called acne mechanica. This form of acne occurs when the skin experiences irritation from excess pressure, heat, and rubbing.
Here are a few easy ways to avoid and treat “mask-ne.”
